title: Extended range_string to 64 bit
description: range_string can currently not be used with guint64 values. This fix allows the use of guint64 values as value_min/value_max.

may be create range_string64 ?

I don't think this is required. Michael started adding 64 bits support to range_strings 3 years ago but it seems like he forgot this part.
I do not have the time to do a proper review currently (no spare time at all) so do not hesitate anyone to review it.
